user.description: Choose the display you want to add. Displays that are in range of a Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy are listed.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Home Assistant connects to the display once to find out the size of its screen.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the display. Make sure it is powered on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and not connected to the iDotMatrix app.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup of this display is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No iDotMatrix displays found. Make sure they are powered on, in range and not connected to the iDotMatrix app.
abort.not_supported: This display type is not supported yet

init.title: iDotMatrix options
init.description: Every new Bluetooth connection makes the display play an animation, so the connection is kept open. You can close it after some idle time to free the display for the iDotMatrix app, or the connection slot of a Bluetooth proxy.

data_description.idle_timeout: Seconds without a command until the connection is closed. 0 keeps it open.

command_failed.message: The display did not accept the command: {error}

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {path}. Add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs in the configuration.

download_too_large.message: The download is larger than 20 MB

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Shows a picture on the display. The picture is scaled to the screen.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path of an image file. Its folder must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of an image to download. A path like /api/media_player_proxy/... (f.e. the cover of a media player) is loaded from Home Assistant itself.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A picture from a media source of Home Assistant.

resize_mode.name: Resize mode
resize_mode.description: Fit keeps the whole picture (with a background), fill crops it to cover the screen, stretch distorts it.

palletize.name: Reduce colors
palletize.description: Reduces the picture to a color palette. Good for pixel art, bad for photos.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Color of the bars if the picture does not have the shape of the screen.

png.name: Send as PNG
png.description: Experimental: sends a smaller PNG file instead of raw pixels, which is a little faster.

show_gif.name: Show GIF
show_gif.description: Uploads an animated GIF and plays it.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path of a GIF file. Its folder must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of an image to download. A path like /api/media_player_proxy/... (f.e. the cover of a media player) is loaded from Home Assistant itself.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A picture from a media source of Home Assistant.

resize_mode.name: Resize mode
resize_mode.description: Fit keeps the whole picture (with a background), fill crops it to cover the screen, stretch distorts it.

palletize.name: Reduce colors
palletize.description: Reduces the colors of the frames. Good for pixel art.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Color for transparent pixels and bars.

duration_per_frame.name: Frame duration
duration_per_frame.description: Duration of each frame in milliseconds. Defaults to the one of the GIF.

color_mode.name: Color mode
color_mode.description: White, the given color or a rainbow.

color.name: Color
color.description: Color of the text, for the color mode RGB.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Color behind the text. Black by default.

show_clock.name: Show clock
show_clock.description: Shows the clock. What is not given is taken from the settings of the clock entities.

set_effect.name: Show effect
set_effect.description: Shows an animated effect with the given colors.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: Two to seven colors as [red, green, blue] lists.

action.name: Action
action.description: What to do with the countdown.

action.name: Action
action.description: What to do with the stopwatch.

score_1.name: Score 1
score_1.description: Score of the first side, 0 to 999.

score_2.name: Score 2
score_2.description: Score of the second side, 0 to 999.

set_pixels.name: Set pixels
set_pixels.description: Colors single pixels of the display, on top of what is shown.

pixels.name: Pixels
pixels.description: List of [x, y] coordinates, starting at 0.

set_eco.name: Set eco mode
set_eco.description: Dims the display between two times.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the eco mode is on.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When the display is back to normal.

music_sync.name: Music sync
music_sync.description: Lets the display react to sound with its own microphone. Show something else (f.e. the clock) to leave it.

start_slideshow.name: Start slideshow
start_slideshow.description: Shows the pictures of a folder one after another, over and over. The folder is read again every round, so new pictures show up. Showing anything else ends the slideshow.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: A folder of the file system. It must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

media_content_id.name: Media folder
media_content_id.description: A folder of a media source of Home Assistant, f.e. media-source://media_source/local/party/. The media browser cannot select folders, so type the id.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: How long each picture is shown. Uploading takes a few seconds.

recursive.name: Include subfolders
recursive.description: Also shows the pictures of the subfolders (up to 8 levels deep).

store.name: Store on the display
store.description: Stores the pictures in the slots of the display, which then cycles through them by itself: the animation is not interrupted by uploads, and Bluetooth is not used afterwards. Interval is the time each picture is shown. The folder is not read again, and only as many pictures as there are slots are stored. Showing anything else ends it.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The slots of the display that may be overwritten when storing. All 12 if empty. Other slots are not touched.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Shows the pictures in random order.

resize_mode.name: Resize mode
resize_mode.description: Fit keeps the whole picture (with a background), fill crops it to cover the screen, stretch distorts it.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Color of the bars if the picture does not have the shape of the screen.

stop_slideshow.name: Stop slideshow
stop_slideshow.description: Ends the slideshow. The display keeps showing the last picture.
